Context: 5. Final payment of accumulations in PF

Missing credits in GPF accumulations.It is mandatory for all offices maintaining GPF accounts to intimate the particulars of missing credits, once every financial year, to the concerned subscriber. Also, a complete statement of all credits, debits and interest since inception of the account shall be provided to every subscriber compulsorily two years before the date of retirement.
